liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Weight** (1 review): Opened the second set and was judged totally awesome by the reviewer [4]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Described as touching, a favorite late Dead song, followed by a surprise return to Playin' to close [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Masterpiece**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [12]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told**: rare: 12 archived performances [12]
- **Mississippi Half Step/Uptown Todeloo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **Playin' in the Band Reprise**: rare: 12 archived performances [12]
- Earliest performances in the archive: The Weight [12]

## The recordings

- **deadandco2017-11-28.peluso.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 183 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **deadco2017-11-28.SchoepsCCM4V**: source not stated; 19 songs; 181 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording captures the room faithfully, including the hollow, big-empty-box acoustics of the arena; Recording reflects the room's sound: good mics, well-placed, with a cavernous quality; Recorded very close to the stage, old-school style, with a few balloon pops and chatty fans, but listenable [2][3][10]

## Around the show

- Talkative fans standing behind the reviewer disrupted their enjoyment of the show [4]
- Reviewer had seen Oteil twice before; praised his singing voice [4]
- Says the upload's date was wrong; the show was on the 28th, not the 29th [6]
- Oteil took a larger vocal role, singing on several songs [9]
- Lineup: Weir, Hart, Kreutzmann, John Mayer, Oteil Burbridge and Jeff Chimenti, all with listed instruments and vocals [2]
- Setlist felt like an early 1990s-era Dead show; reviewer still waiting to hear St. Stephen [10]
- The first set was stronger than the second [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandco2017-11-28.peluso.flac24**: taped by Chris Davis and George; transferred by Chris Davis; source: Peluso cemc6/ck41 [narrow Rainey/loc/luxury suite/railing clamp] -> E.A.A. PSP-2 -> Tascam DR-680 [24/48] [1]
- **deadco2017-11-28.SchoepsCCM4V**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V's>Lunatec V2>Sound Devices 722 (24/44) [2]. Also: Taped by Z-Man, who is credited with the pull; Z-Man trimmed about 1:45 of crowd noise from the first set to fit on a CD; no music lost [2][3]
